episodes.name: Now and Then
episodes.overview: The BAU hunts kidnappers targeting couples as Elias Voit faces a familiar darkness in prison.

episodes.name: Cluster
episodes.overview: The BAU investigates a veteran's death as Prentiss and Voit move to shut down a podcast from conspiracy theorist Brian Garrity.

episodes.name: Body Count
episodes.overview: When new bodies are linked to Sicarius, the BAU takes Voit into the field to verify the killings.

episodes.name: The Witching Hour
episodes.overview: An UnSub terrorizes spouses before killing one and sparing the other. Meanwhile, Voit receives disturbing mail from The Fan, a mysterious admirer.

episodes.name: Friendly Fire
episodes.overview: Alvez and Tyler team up to investigate the murder of an FBI training instructor, while the rest of the BAU explore ways to lure out The Fan.

episodes.name: Proxy
episodes.overview: The team investigates The Fan, while Brian Garrity questions the damage caused by his podcast.

episodes.name: The Furies
episodes.overview: While the BAU investigates a cop killer, Voit receives an enigmatic new visitor.

episodes.name: Requiem
episodes.overview: Voit asks the BAU for help after he is threatened by The Fan, and the team must race to stop an UnSub before he can finish his chilling work with his latest victim.

episodes.name: Special Agent Garrity
episodes.overview: After The Fan sets his sights on Brian Garrity and Voit devises a strategy to deal with his nemesis, the BAU must use their profiling prowess to identify The Fan and save their ally.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: The Fan's twisted past and the ultimate showdown will be revealed in the climactic finale to Season Nineteen.
